notes: A152718_motzkin (A152718_mathlib.lean): mk A054393 = (mk A152718).subst zM with zM = X*(1+zM+zM^2) (zM = x M(x)); A152718_motzkin_coeff: A054393(n) = sum_{k<=n} A152718(k) [x^n] zM^k. A054393(n) = w n 0, closed walks on levels 0,1,2,... with up-1 steps, drops to any lower level, loops only at levels 0..4. Route: candidate series V_j = X^j U_j (U_j rational in z) and tails T_j satisfy the walk recursion (algE0..algE5, algT via linear_combination; D0, D1, D2, DT); uniqueness by induction on length (coeff_V); g.f. of the recurrence (gfB) and substitution (subst_eq). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: that the walk recursion w is the OEIS definition of A054393 (Alcover's matrix power; certificate/check.py compares for n <= 40 and with the b-file terms).
